item.q: How often? Complete: I ___ drink coffee in the evening because it keeps me awake.
item.why: A word for how often (*never, rarely*) goes before the main verb: *I never drink coffee in the evening.*
item.why_lv: Biežuma vārds (*never, rarely*) stāv pirms darbības vārda: *I never drink coffee in the evening.*
